justification: Frontend-only: replace the raw terrain number-dump (Slope Mean Deg, Aspect Dominant Deg, ...) with a TerrainCard — an aspect compass (SVG), a plain-English summary sentence, and four clean stats. Reads the existing satellite.terrain section payload (TerrainAnalysisDetail fields the backend already streams); no new data source, API, or backend change.

pre_impl.existing_data: The backend already streams section 'satellite.terrain' as a DataField whose .value is TerrainAnalysisDetail with slope_mean_deg, slope_max_deg, aspect_dominant_deg, aspect_direction, elevation_range_m, drainage_direction, landform_type (verified in services/terrain_analysis.py:97-111 and the emit at services/intelligence_brief.py:3404). The brief rendered these as a raw key/value list.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The terrain numbers were technically present but unreadable (degrees, bearings, no interpretation). The fix is presentation only — the same fields, shown as a compass + sentence.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new component is strictly required but a focused TerrainCard is added alongside the existing SeppHousingCard special-case; it consumes the already-streamed section. AspectCompass is a pure SVG from one number. No new fetch, API, or DB query.
pre_impl.external_source_error: No external call is added. If the terrain field is missing or slope_mean_deg is null, the special-case does not fire and the section falls back to the existing SectionCard (which shows the contextual empty-state / raw fields exactly as before).
pre_impl.frontend_type: Frontend only (TypeScript/React). TerrainData is a local interface with all-optional nullable fields; every render path guards null with `!= null` / `?? '—'`. tsc --noEmit passes.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Before: a column of cryptic numbers (Aspect Dominant Deg 24.7). After: a compass pointing NE plus 'Gently sloping (~2.8°, up to 23°), faces NE, ~26 m of fall across the lot, drains southwest.' If terrain wasn't run, the card doesn't render and the empty-state shows.

functions.name: TerrainCard
functions.output: a card with an aspect compass, a plain-English summary, and four stat cells; every field guarded against null
functions.if_none: fields that are null render as '—'; if slope_mean_deg is null the card is never selected and SectionCard renders instead

functions.name: slopeWord
functions.input: mean slope in degrees (number or null)
functions.output: a plain-English band: Flat / Gently sloping / Moderately sloping / Noticeably sloping / Steep / Very steep
functions.if_none: returns the neutral word 'Slope' when the input is null

values: N/A - no regulatory values. Slope/aspect/elevation are computed terrain metrics from the existing DEM pipeline; the descriptive bands (Flat/Gently sloping/...) are presentation labels, not planning controls, and nothing is hardcoded from regulation.
queries: N/A - no new database or API query. Reads the satellite.terrain section already present in the stream.

break_it.scenario: Terrain analysis was not requested (satellite off) so the section value is null
break_it.what_happens: a naive card could render an empty compass and blank stats that look broken
break_it.repro: the special-case requires t && t.slope_mean_deg != null; otherwise card stays unset
break_it.how: falls through to the existing SectionCard which shows the contextual empty-state, unchanged

break_it.scenario: Aspect is null but slope is present (partial terrain result)
break_it.what_happens: the compass needle could point at an arbitrary default (0=N) implying a false 'faces north'
break_it.repro: AspectCompass only draws the needle when deg != null; the label shows '—' and the summary omits the 'faces' clause
break_it.how: needle and direction text are both guarded; the summary is built from only the present clauses

break_it.scenario: The section arrives as a plain dict in some path rather than a DataField wrapper
break_it.what_happens: reading .value would be undefined and the card would never render
break_it.repro: extraction is `raw.value ?? raw` so both the wrapped and unwrapped shapes resolve to the terrain object
break_it.how: dual fallback handles both; the slope_mean_deg guard still gates rendering

break_it.scenario: All numeric fields present but elevation_range_m and drainage are null
break_it.what_happens: the summary could end with a dangling comma or empty clause
break_it.repro: the summary is assembled from a parts[] array joined by ', ' with only non-null clauses pushed
break_it.how: empty parts collapse to a single fallback sentence; no dangling punctuation

break_it.scenario: slope_max_deg is null while slope_mean_deg is set
break_it.what_happens: the 'up to N°' fragment could render 'up to °' or 'up to null°'
break_it.repro: the max fragment is conditional on slope_max_deg != null in both the summary and the stat cell
break_it.how: the 'up to' clause and the '· N° max' suffix are each guarded; only avg shows when max is null

post_merge.manual_verify: Run a brief with satellite analysis on (e.g. a Sydney address). The Terrain section should show a compass pointing the aspect direction, a plain-English sentence, and Slope/Fall/Drains-to/Landform stats — not the raw 'Slope Mean Deg' list. Run a brief with satellite off: the Terrain section should show its empty-state, not a broken card.
